title: Coalgebra laws descend through an injective linear map
statement: Let k be a field, C a k-vector space with a k-coalgebra structure (Δ_C,ε_C), and V a k-vector space. Let i:V→C be an injective k-linear map, δ:V→V⊗_k V a k-linear map, and ε:V→k a k-linear map. Assume (i⊗i)(δ(v))=Δ_C(i(v)) and ε(v)=ε_C(i(v)) for every v∈V. Then, writing α_V:(V⊗V)⊗V→V⊗(V⊗V) for the tensor associator, every v∈V satisfies α_V((δ⊗id_V)(δ(v)))=(id_V⊗δ)(δ(v)), (ε⊗id_V)(δ(v))=1⊗v, and (id_V⊗ε)(δ(v))=v⊗1. All tensor products are over k.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {C : Type*} [AddCommGroup C] [Module k C] [Coalgebra k C] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] (i : V →ₗ[k] C) (_hi : Function.Injective i) (δ : V →ₗ[k] TensorProduct k V V) (ε : V →ₗ[k] k) (_hδ : ∀ v : V, TensorProduct.map i i (δ v) = Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (i v)) (_hε : ∀ v : V, ε v = Coalgebra.counit (R := k) (i v)), (∀ v : V, TensorProduct.assoc k V V V (TensorProduct.map δ (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) (δ v)) = TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) δ (δ v)) ∧ (∀ v : V, TensorProduct.map ε (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) (δ v) = TensorProduct.tmul k (1 : k) v) ∧ (∀ v : V, TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) ε (δ v) = TensorProduct.tmul k v (1 : k))
